text:
liam: quick poke 1: started onboarding Salient-7B fork. conversion + int4 quant looked fine but convo-QA EM down ~6.5% vs fp16 baseline.
maya: can you dump convert/quant flags and any warnings?
liam: commands:
```
python convert_tool.py --src models/salient_fp16 --dst builds/salient_shelf --emit-tokenmap --normalize-vocab
python quantize.py --model builds/salient_shelf --dtype int4 --block 64 --calib 2048 --rotary-auto
```
Convert emitted: `WARN: duplicate sentinel tokens found, vocab normalized (50272 -> 50256)`. Also wrote tokenmap_bridge.json.
anya: duplicate sentinels = classic shadowing. Curious that convert normalized vocab by merging tokens; that can shift embedding slots nontrivially. Did you try applying tokenmap_bridge at load?
liam: loader ignored tokenmap_bridge because model.meta.vocab_sha matched expected. I tried a quick manual remap at load and saw large quality gain.
sam: can you run quick AB: (1) fp16 roundtrip + bridge remap (2) int4 quant + bridge remap (3) int4 quant + hybrid-emb + bridge remap (4) int4 quant + bridge remap + rotary_scale=0.72. Keep batch=1.
maya: ran 1-4 on staging (1k conv-QA samples):
```
1) roundtrip+bridge: EM=94.2 (fp16 baseline 95.1), p95 latency=118ms
2) int4+bridge: EM=89.5, latency=50ms
3) int4+bridge+hybrid-emb: EM=92.7, latency=55ms
4) int4+bridge+rotary=0.72: EM=90.1, latency=51ms
```
liam: bridge remap recovers most of the gap; hybrid-emb gives a big boost. rotary tweak helps slightly but not primary.
anya: interesting note: when convert normalized vocabulary by merging duplicate sentinels it reused Gemma-style merge heuristics. We should document that behavior and expose `--merge-sentinels` explicitly instead of implicit normalization.
sam: ops items: 1) make convert fail or require `--accept-vocab-normalization` when vocab shrinks 2) have loader auto-apply tokenmap_bridge if present and warn loudly 3) quantizer should detect tokenmap and recommend hybrid embedding by default for int4 builds for models with sentinel merges
maya: added a tiny diagnostic tool `rwd-token-bridge-check` that prints token id pairs that moved and a quick embed-diff for the top N tokens. I'll add it to PR.
liam: opened PR with loader auto-remap + diagnostics + test that asserts embedding parity for 2048 sampled tokens after remap: https://rwd/pr/1317
deploy-bot: salient-7b-int4-bridgebuild uploaded to staging, tag=salient-bridge-int4-2026-03-26
sam: can we schedule a 2k long-context sweep on the bridge+hybrid build? we saw rotation-phase drift after 1k in another model.
maya: scheduled overnight. If longctx looks good we'll make bridge+hybrid the default onboarding path for this fork and add an onboarding checklist entry about sentinel/merge normalization.
anya: doc blurb for release notes: "Salient-7B (community fork): converter may normalize duplicated sentinel tokens; use token-bridge remap and consider hybrid embeddings for int4 to avoid QA regressions."
liam: thanks all, will post longctx results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
